# harness-kit

Project-agnostic AI agent harness with stage orchestration, bounded loops, and MCP context tools.

## Capability taxonomy
- Autonomy tier: bounded
- Recovery tier: resumable
- Simplicity tier: slightly complex
- Tags: mcp, memory, workflow, evals, provider-agnostic, cli, typescript, tool-discovery

## Intent profiles
- turnkey-coding: profile=turnkey-coding; keywords=turnkey coding, ship feature, coding agent, implement feature, build feature
- multi-agent-orchestration: profile=multi-agent-orchestration; keywords=multi-agent, orchestration, handoff, coordination, agent workflow
- drop-in-memory: profile=drop-in-memory; keywords=memory layer, persistent memory, session memory, recall, knowledge memory
- wayfinder: profile=wayfinder; keywords=multi-session, too big for one session, wayfinder, decision map, fog of war, chart the map, large effort
- coder: profile=coder; keywords=write code, implement function, fix bug, add feature, refactor, coder mode, just code it, code only, quick code
- assistant: profile=assistant; keywords=what is, explain, summarise, summarize, help me understand, quick question, assistant mode, answer only, search for, find

## Domain model specialists
- frontend: tier=balanced-coding; primary=claude-sonnet-5; fallback=gpt-5.4, gpt-5.3-codex; companionSkills=implement, prototype, deterministic-validation; advisoryOnly=true
- ui-ux: tier=ultra-reasoning; primary=gpt-5.6-sol; fallback=claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5; companionSkills=architect, prototype, review-breadth; advisoryOnly=true
- database: tier=high-reasoning; primary=claude-opus-5; fallback=gpt-5.5, claude-opus-4-8; companionSkills=doubt-driven-development, deterministic-validation, review-depth; advisoryOnly=true
- infrastructure: tier=high-reasoning; primary=gpt-5.5; fallback=claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8; companionSkills=setup-harness-bootstrap, doubt-driven-development, deterministic-validation; advisoryOnly=true
- backend: tier=balanced-coding; primary=gpt-5.4; fallback=gpt-5.3-codex, claude-sonnet-5; companionSkills=implement, observability-and-instrumentation, deterministic-validation; advisoryOnly=true

## Model selection wizard
- Supported model snapshot: 2026-08-07
- Source: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/ai-models/supported-models
- Supported model count: 20
- cheap: cost=1/3; quality=1/3; defaults=gpt-5-mini, gemini-3.5-flash, claude-haiku-4-5
- balanced: cost=2/3; quality=2/3; defaults=gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.3-codex
- high: cost=3/3; quality=3/3; defaults=gpt-5.6-sol, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.5
### Mode packages
- assistant/cheap: cloud=gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5-mini, mai-code-1-flash; local=qwen2.5:latest; context=local 32K; cloud long-context on Luna when enabled
- assistant/balanced: cloud=gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-5; local=qwen2.5-coder:14b; context=local 32K; cloud 1M on Terra/GPT-5.4/Sonnet 5 when enabled
- assistant/high: cloud=gpt-5.6-sol, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.5; local=devstral:24b; context=local 131K; cloud 1M on all listed high models when enabled
- dev/cheap: cloud=gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.6-luna; local=qwen2.5:latest; context=local 32K; cheap cloud defaults are best for small edits
- dev/balanced: cloud=gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.3-codex; local=qwen2.5-coder:14b; context=local 32K; cloud 1M on GPT-5.4/Sonnet 5 when enabled
- dev/high: cloud=gpt-5.6-sol, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.5; local=devstral:24b; context=local 131K; use for multi-file implementation and review
- super-plus/cheap: cloud=gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5-mini, mai-code-1-flash; local=qwen2.5-coder:14b; context=local 32K; suitable for bounded super-plus dry runs only
- super-plus/balanced: cloud=gpt-5.6-terra, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.4; local=devstral:24b; context=local 131K; cloud 1M on all listed balanced models when enabled
- super-plus/high: cloud=gpt-5.6-sol, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.5; local=devstral:24b; context=local 131K; qwen2.5-coder:32b remains a slower optional deep-code fallback

## Notes
- Use `npm run harness:profile -- --task "<task>" --json` to map a task to an intent profile.
- Use `npm run harness:mcp -- harness-tool-discover --intent <intent>` for on-demand tool routing.
